items.en: I feel that I'm a person of worth, at least on an equal plane with others.
items.zh: 我觉得自己是一个有价值的人，至少与其他人同样有价值。

items.en: I feel that I have a number of good qualities.
items.zh: 我觉得自己有不少好的品质。

items.en: All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.
items.zh: 总的来说，我倾向于觉得自己是个失败者。

items.en: I am able to do things as well as most other people.
items.zh: 我做事情能和大多数其他人做得一样好。

items.en: I feel I do not have much to be proud of.
items.zh: 我觉得自己没有多少值得自豪的地方。

items.en: I take a positive attitude toward myself.
items.zh: 我对自己持积极的态度。

items.en: On the whole, I am satisfied with myself.
items.zh: 总体而言，我对自己感到满意。

items.en: I wish I could have more respect for myself.
items.zh: 我希望自己能更尊重自己一些。

items.en: I certainly feel useless at times.
items.zh: 有时候，我确实觉得自己没有用。

items.en: At times I think I am no good at all.
items.zh: 有时候，我觉得自己一无是处。

instructions: 下面是一些关于你对自己总体感受的陈述。请根据你的实际感受，选择你对每句话的同意程度。
